active_directory.description:
Specifies the Active Directory policy to be used. Format: 'projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/activeDirectories/{{name}}'.
The policy needs to be in the same location as the storage pool.
active_directory.rationale: References an external Active Directory resource.

allow_auto_tiering.description:
Optional. True if the storage pool supports Auto Tiering enabled volumes. Default is false.
Auto-tiering can be enabled after storage pool creation but it can't be disabled once enabled.
allow_auto_tiering.rationale: Controls automatic data movement between performance and cost storage tiers and is an operational data-management setting rather than a security control.

capacity_gib.description: Capacity of the storage pool (in GiB).
capacity_gib.rationale: Defines the storage capacity allocated to the pool and is an operational resource-sizing setting rather than a security control.

custom_performance_enabled.description: Optional. True if using Independent Scaling of capacity and performance (Hyperdisk). Default is false.
custom_performance_enabled.rationale: Controls independent performance scaling and is an operational performance configuration rather than a security control.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: Controls whether the storage pool can be deleted. Helps to prevent accidental deletion of required resources.

description.description: An optional description of this resource.
description.rationale: Provides descriptive information about the storage pool and does not affect its security configuration.

enable_hot_tier_auto_resize.description:
Flag indicating that the hot-tier threshold will be auto-increased by 10% of the hot-tier when it hits 100%. Default is true.
The increment will kick in only if the new size after increment is still less than or equal to storage pool size.
enable_hot_tier_auto_resize.rationale: Controls automatic resizing of the hot storage tier and is an operational capacity-management setting rather than a security control.

hot_tier_size_gib.description:
Total hot tier capacity for the Storage Pool. It is applicable only to Flex service level.
It should be less than the minimum storage pool size and cannot be more than the current storage pool size. It cannot be decreased once set.
hot_tier_size_gib.rationale: Defines the size of the hot storage tier and is an operational storage-allocation choice rather than a security control.

kms_config.description:
Specifies the CMEK policy to be used for volume encryption. Format: 'projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/kmsConfigs/{{name}}'.
The policy needs to be in the same location as the storage pool.
kms_config.rationale: Configures customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) for the storage pool. Policies can require a non-empty KMS configuration to ensure customer-managed encryption is used without pinning a specific key.

labels.description:
Labels as key value pairs. Example: '{ "owner": "Bob", "department": "finance", "purpose": "testing" }'.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Provides descriptive metadata for organizing resources and does not directly affect the security configuration of the storage pool.

ldap_enabled.description:
When enabled, the volumes uses Active Directory as LDAP name service for UID/GID lookups. Required to enable extended group support for NFSv3,
using security identifiers for NFSv4.1 or principal names for kerberized NFSv4.1.
ldap_enabled.rationale: Controls whether LDAP functionality is enabled for the storage pool and is an operational directory-service feature rather than a security policy enforcement control.

location.description: Name of the location. For zonal Flex pools specify a zone name, in all other cases a region name.
location.rationale: Determines where the storage pool is created. Using approved locations helps keep data in the correct region.

mode.description:
Mode of the storage pool.
The operational mode of the storage pool. ONTAP mode enables operations
via ONTAP Mode APIs, while DEFAULT mode enables operations via NetApp Volumes APIs.
If not specified during creation, the mode defaults to DEFAULT. Possible values: ["MODE_UNSPECIFIED", "DEFAULT", "ONTAP"]
mode.rationale: Defines the operational mode of the storage pool, such as service-managed or flexible mode, and represents an architectural choice rather than a security control.

name.description: The resource name of the storage pool. Needs to be unique per location/region.
name.rationale: Specifies the name of the storage pool and is an identifier that does not directly affect its security posture.

network.rationale: References the VPC network used by the storage pool. Resource references are not policy targets because the policy should not restrict specific resource names or identifiers.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Identifies the Google Cloud project containing the resource. Project identifiers are reference fields and are not security policy targets.

qos_type.description:
QoS (Quality of Service) type of the storage pool.
Possible values are: AUTO, MANUAL. Possible values: ["QOS_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED", "AUTO", "MANUAL"]
qos_type.rationale: Controls storage performance. It does not affect security.

replica_zone.description:
Specifies the replica zone for regional Flex pools. 'zone' and 'replica_zone' values can be swapped to initiate a
[zone switch](https://cloud.google.com/netapp/volumes/docs/configure-and-use/storage-pools/edit-or-delete-storage-pool#switch_active_and_replica_zones).
replica_zone.rationale: Determines the zone used for storage replication and can affect data residency. Policies can restrict replica zones to approved locations that meet organizational or regulatory requirements.

scale_type.description: The scale type of the storage pool. Defaults to 'SCALE_TYPE_DEFAULT' if not specified. Possible values: ["SCALE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED", "SCALE_TYPE_DEFAULT", "SCALE_TYPE_SCALEOUT"]
scale_type.rationale: Controls how the storage pool grows when needed. It does not affect security.

service_level.description: Service level of the storage pool. Possible values: ["PREMIUM", "EXTREME", "STANDARD", "FLEX"]
service_level.rationale: Controls the storage performance level. It does not affe

total_iops.description: Optional. Custom Performance Total IOPS of the pool If not provided, it will be calculated based on the totalThroughputMibps
total_iops.rationale: Controls how many storage operations can happen each second. It affects performance, not security.

total_throughput_mibps.description: Optional. Custom Performance Total Throughput of the pool (in MiB/s).
total_throughput_mibps.rationale: Determines how quickly data can move through the storage pool. It affects performance, not security.

type.description:
Type of the storage pool.
This field is used to control whether the pool supports FILE based volumes only or UNIFIED (both FILE and BLOCK) volumes.
If not specified during creation, it defaults to FILE. Possible values: ["STORAGE_POOL_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED", "FILE", "UNIFIED"]
type.rationale: Defines the storage pool type or protocol and represents a functional architectural choice rather than a security control.

zone.description:
Specifies the active zone for regional Flex pools. 'zone' and 'replica_zone' values can be swapped to initiate a
[zone switch](https://cloud.google.com/netapp/volumes/docs/configure-and-use/storage-pools/edit-or-delete-storage-pool#switch_active_and_replica_zones).
If you want to create a zonal Flex pool, specify a zone name for 'location' and omit 'zone'.
zone.rationale: Determines the zone where the storage pool is deployed and therefore affects data residency. Policies can restrict deployment to approved regions or zones to meet organizational and regulatory requirements.
